about_short_description.short_description: Prembly is a KYC Verification Company.

product.name: KYC Verification Solutions
product.description: Provides tools and infrastructure for Know Your Customer (KYC) verification to support compliance and identity verification processes.

product.name: KYB Verification Solutions
product.description: Provides tools for Know Your Business (KYB) verification to validate business entities and ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

product.name: AML and CFT Compliance Tools
product.description: Offers tools to support Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter Financing of Terrorism (CFT) compliance through data verification and monitoring.

product.name: Background Checks
product.description: Conducts background checks to verify individual or business information for compliance and risk assessment purposes.

product.name: FraudLens
product.description: FraudLens is a Prembly platform that shares real-time fraud intelligence across financial institutions to block repeat attacks.
